trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is no separate task. Work through the roadmap in order: finish the story, then the 100% checklist, then the stranger strands and clean-up. Expect around 200 hours in total. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Reach 100% in the in-game Progress menu. It needs everything in full — all robberies including 8 vaults and 39 gang operations, every Shooting Range gold, all drone races, Bret's 15 Target Decks and the underwater discoveries — plus partial counts: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Check Progress often; it shows exactly what is left. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Finish the last story mission. Keep a manual save from before you start it — there is no mission replay and no New Game+, so a save at the start of the final chapter is your safety net if anything goes wrong. The trophy pops when the mission ends. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the story order.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida: 130 jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the fastest way to rack them up, and the map marks every Stunt Spot. The optional challenge on each stunt is not needed. Track the count under Progress, Activities, Stunts. 100% completion wants 300. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the stunt totals.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Learn each range's layout first with a practice run, then go for gold — steady aim beats speed on the precision lanes. The range menu shows which challenges still need gold. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the range count.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.guide: Rob 5 vaults and escape each time. Vault jobs open from the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…': follow a security van to its bank, then haul the cash out. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Expect 4 stars every time and up to $205,000 a job. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the vault method.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count toward it; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed, so watch the in-game trophy progress counter and work every stranger icon you see. Do Yago's Race Against Yago the moment its hourglass icon appears in Chapter 3 — it is time-sensitive. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for which strands count.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. Cards are found across Leonida — check shops, hideouts and mission rewards — and the collection menu shows which sets are close to done, so finish the nearly-complete sets first. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the card sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK — hold Up on the D-pad, then R1/RB — at 100 locations: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures plus No Flusher tags. Scan everything you pass while doing other tasks and the count climbs on its own; 100% completion wants 100 scans. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the WAiNK counts.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Gone Fishing. It pops at the end of the mission — just play the story. This is also where you first meet Cal, who later texts you about fishing challenges. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the mission order.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Chapter trophies sometimes pop on the first mission of the next chapter, so do not worry if it does not appear the instant the last Chapter 1 mission ends — it lands when Chapter 2 begins. Before you leave Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation: it may be the only missable spot in the game. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the chapter order.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. The name is censored as 'T**s' in PlayStation's own listing and in the public guides, and this guide uses it exactly as published. It pops after the mission Welcome to Vice City, as Chapter 3 begins. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the name as published; GTABase and Outputlag for the chapter order.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It pops after the missions Ocean Beach and Another Life, as Chapter 4 begins. Chapter 3 is also where several side strands open — Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, Andy's missions for Lucia, Tyrone's labs — so clear those before moving on. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the chapter order.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Chapter 4 opens the optional vault mission 'That's Where The Money Is…', so once this trophy pops, vault robberies are on the table for Maximum Withdrawal. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the chapter order.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It pops at the end of the mission — just play the story. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the mission order.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. This is a scripted story heist, not a free-roam bank vault robbery, so it does not count toward Maximum Withdrawal — that trophy needs the repeatable vault jobs. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the mission order.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It pops at the end of the mission — just play the story. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the mission order.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It pops at the end of the mission — just play the story. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the mission order.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It pops at the end of the mission — just play the story. The airport itself is also the scene of the one-off Catch Me If You Can. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the mission order.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops at the end of the mission — just play the story. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the mission order.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Andy is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville. His five missions run in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, then Puff Puff Pass. The trophy pops when the fifth ends. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for Andy's mission order.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. Kenton sends you diving for 7 shipwrecks: dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig up treasure. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so do not worry if he goes quiet. Track the finds under Progress, Collections, Kenton's Treasures. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for Kenton's wrecks.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. Billy's 5 jobs run at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, and the fifth — Hometown Heroes — awards the trophy. The jobs stay available after the story ends. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for Billy's jobs.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS): deliver 16 sports cars to his garage in west Vice City. Scan cars with WAiNK to see if they are on the list, and check hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. Better condition pays more. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for Randy's list.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. Tyrone is Jason-only: after Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City, then play Shut Down the Labs. The labs are the grind; the finale is short. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for Tyrone's labs.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when he texts Jason; Veteran Hunted in Lummox County comes first. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks and bring them back as Jason — a clean one-shot kill pays more, but is not required. Which animal triggers this trophy is not confirmed yet, and 100% needs all 15 Target Decks. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for Bret's hunts.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race), and a stunt. None needs to be mastered — one try each is enough, so knock the quick ones out early. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the 9 activities.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — 42 races exist in total, but one win per location is enough for the trophy. Learn each course's corners before racing flat out; a clean line beats raw speed. 100% wants all 42 races. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the 14 locations.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on offer. The same race twice does not count, so work through the list — car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races all count toward the 20. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the race count.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. You meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui; afterwards he texts you and marks a fishing spot on the map. Play through his fishing quests until the challenge unlocks, then out-fish him — steady reeling and watching the line tension matters more than speed. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for Cal's quests.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. There are 3 games on the TV at home — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — plus Bang For Your Buck on arcade cabinets around Leonida. Pick the shortest one and play it through to the end. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the arcade games.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. WARNING — possibly missable, the only one in the game: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1, on the morning after Down to Earth, disappears after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether that spot is required. Do it the first chance you get. Meditating with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, and the last spot needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track the count under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the meditation spots and the Chapter 1 warning.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 Challenges. Progress, Challenges marks finished ones with a tick, so work the easy ones first — driving, shooting and exploration challenges stack up while you play normally. 100% wants 70. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the challenge count.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Both characters must be together, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. The easiest reliable 4-star heat is a bank vault robbery — the vault always draws 4 stars. To shake the cops, take the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: it drops helicopters and breaks line of sight. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the tunnel escape.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level — keep the heat on the whole run, and do not let the cops drop off between shops. Three jewelry stores in north Vice City sit close together and work well, once Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs open in Chapter 3. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the shop run.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK — you do not need to drive them. Stand beside a busy road and scan everything that passes; traffic-dense streets in Vice City fill the count fast. 100% wants 200 of 277 scans. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the scanning method.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is triggered by clicking both sticks while aiming — fill the Focus meter first by eating, drinking and washing up at home, and Adrenaline extends it. Use an assault rifle and pick a gang operation: its thugs count, while cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to. Line the targets up before you trigger it. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the Focus method.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3: use it on the locked back door, since kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside, find the note with the safe code in the back room. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the Snap Gun method.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Box the truck in with your car, then use a sticky bomb on its back doors to crack it open — or, if you are already running vault jobs, a bank vault robbery and escape also counts toward this one. Grab the cash and break line of sight before the cops close in. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the truck method.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane — fly a grid over the state and watch the fog peel back, then mop up the corners on foot or by car. It pairs naturally with the stunt and WAiNK grinds. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the map coverage.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs — look for the yellow icons on the map. Progress, Gangs keeps the count per gang. 100% needs all 39 operations, so this trophy is the first step of a much longer grind. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the gang operations.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. First get the Dye Pack Jammer from the mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew, Chapter 3). Bank vault hauls and Payday Loan hits leave you holding marked bills — sell them to fences, and Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total is a running count, so it builds up across the game. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the laundering method.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. It is a running total, so normal play contributes — guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest ways to push it over the line if you are close. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the spending total.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate phone app, which opens after Daily Driver in Chapter 2. They cost about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count — only the 8 bought ones do. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the garage list.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the app: take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray and register them. At first only cars without trackers can be registered; from Chapter 3 any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones too. You need free garage space, and each registration costs money — use cheap cars and bikes. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the registration method.
trophies.name: On the Spot

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a big passenger jet docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge and take off — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Gates E3 and E4 are easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge, then get about 1 km away. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the gate method.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get inside a Rhino tank. Head to Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County — the tanks sit at the south end of the base. Expect soldiers to object; bring a fast escape vehicle or be ready to fight your way out in the tank itself. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the tank location.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down: the exact steps for this one have not been confirmed in the game yet, so this guide will not invent a method. The best reading of the official description is to find a bar or cocktail spot with a view on Ocean Beach and order a drink there — likely at a beachfront venue. Check back: this entry will be updated when the steps are confirmed. Sources: Exophase for the official description.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down: the exact steps for this one have not been confirmed in the game yet, so this guide will not invent a method. The best reading of the official description is to drive a vehicle straight through the front of a vehicle showroom — the classic way out. Try a showroom in Vice City and be ready for the cops. Sources: Exophase for the official description.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn. The alley is a gang operation, first marked by the mission Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Three valuables are inside: a luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a northeast table, and a safe in the northeast hallway — bring sticky bombs for the safe. The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three valuables in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the bowling alley method.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia. Check the level in the pause menu under Jason & Lucia, Strength, then work out at fitness clubs — the map's Activities layer marks them — with your partner along: training one trains the other too. After the story, you can train at home. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the training method.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Reach 500 Criminal Profile actions. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, UI so you can watch the count climb. Most players get this without trying, just by playing the story and side content. One warning: pushing toward an irredeemable criminal profile is permanent, so do not chase the count recklessly. Sources: GTABase and Outputlag for the profile count.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down: the exact steps for this one have not been confirmed in the game yet, so this guide will not invent a method. The best reading of the official description is that it involves succeeding at something on a second attempt — a retry of a failed activity or challenge. Check back when the steps are confirmed. Sources: Exophase for the official description.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down: the exact steps for this one have not been confirmed in the game yet, so this guide will not invent a method. The best reading of the official description is a strange or surprising scripted moment somewhere in Leonida — an event trophy rather than a grind. Check back when the steps are confirmed. Sources: Exophase for the official description.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down: the exact steps for this one have not been confirmed in the game yet, so this guide will not invent a method. The best reading of the official description is to strike someone down with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a bat or similar weapon rather than a gun. Check back when the steps are confirmed. Sources: Exophase for the official description.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
